criterion1_greenAndRedFileExists.claim: After a green run and after a red run, a file with the final verification_result JSON exists, and verify.ps1's own output names its path.

greenRun.note: Cheap: -Stage scripts needs no engine, no build.
greenRun.fileOnDiskAfterRun: matched stdout exactly, byte for byte

redRun.note: Cheap and deliberate: -Stage build (needs the engine) with a bogus -GodotPath fails in preflight, before any stage or build runs - a real red run without the cost of a real failing check.

criterion2_readChecksumsFromFile.claim: The four checksums are read from the file by a named command.
criterion2_readChecksumsFromFile.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "(Get-Content .artifacts/verify-results/verify-result.json | ConvertFrom-Json) | Select-Object deterministicChecksum, changedSeedChecksum, loadChecksum, viewInvariantChecksum | Format-List"
criterion2_readChecksumsFromFile.crossCheck: All four match evidence/423-verify.json's checksumsAddendum.values byte for byte - expected, since this task does not touch src/** or tests/**, only scripts/ and docs/.

criterion3_mutant.claim: A substitution that breaks saving the result must turn the named check red, applied after committing the reviewable state, reverted before the final rebuild.
criterion3_mutant.committedStateBeforeMutant: 15e20da (guard fix commit, before docs commit ff35fe7 - mutant was applied and reverted against this state, working tree confirmed clean via git status before the edit)
criterion3_mutant.mutantEdit: scripts/VerifyResult.ps1: commented out `[IO.File]::WriteAllText($ResultPath, $Json)`, the single line that writes the persisted result - never committed

wiredStageRun.note: Stage 'scripts' failed because test-verify-result-persistence.ps1 (its own new check) failed inside it.
wiredStageRun.sideFindingUnderMutant: verify.ps1 still printed {"event":"verification_result_file","status":"ok",...} for this run, but .artifacts/verify-results/verify-result.json on disk was left unchanged (still held the previous green run's content) - the mutant broke the write silently, exactly the failure mode this check exists to catch.

criterion3_mutant.revert: Edit reverted verbatim; `git diff` against scripts/VerifyResult.ps1 showed zero difference afterward.

confirmGreenAfterRevert.note: No --no-build involved anywhere in this class of check: scripts/VerifyResult.ps1 and its test are plain PowerShell, not compiled; the revert-then-rerun above is the full, honest rebuild for this class.

stageOutputLogDecision.decision: Not kept on a green run (nothing in it a green run's own verification_result doesn't already say); copied out of the temporary $verifyRoot to .artifacts/verify-results/stage-output.log on a red run, before `finally` deletes the source; a subsequent green run removes any such stale copy.
stageOutputLogDecision.rationale: Matches the existing Issue #284 reasoning already in ENVIRONMENT_SETUP.md for why a green run's full stage dump is not worth opening; a red run's log is exactly the file PR #425 needed and could not get back.
